content: असंबद्ध {%a.%} .²1 Unconnected, incoherent. .²2 Nonsensical, absurd, unmeaning; ˚प्रलापिनी talking nonsense; असंबद्धः खल्वसि <ls>Mk. 9</ls> absurd fellow; ˚मनोरथाः <ls>Māl. 2</ls>; ˚द्धं प्रलपितुं प्रवृत्तः <ls>Ratn. 2</ls>. .²3 Improper, wrong; <ls>Ms. 12. 6</ls>. .²4 Not closely associated, not related; असंबद्धकृतश्चैव व्यवहारो न सिध्यति <ls>Ms. 8. 163</ls>. .{@-द्धम्@} An absurd sentence, unmeaning or nonsensical speech; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} यावज्जीवमहं मौनी when uttered by some one; see अबद्ध also. .{@-अर्थव्यवधान@} {%a.%} Having the interception of an irrelevant matter; तस्मान्नासम्बद्धार्थव्यवधानैकवाक्यता भवति . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 3. 1. 21</ls>.
